items.title: Ed Garland Interview, 1957-04-16
items.q: I said, Ed don't know Lula White if he's here.

ctx.x: That's all. Then you go down there, and you sit and follow your professor. He's playing over there. Lula's house has mirrors all around. See? Mirrors? Mirrors, yeah. And all different little freak lights. All colors. See?
You mean there are mirrors all over the world?
